name: medical-credit-score-workspace
description: Root workspace to manage all applications in the Medical Credit Score System

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix medical_credit_score_system && npm install --prefix provider_admin_portal
scripts.start:all: npx concurrently "npm run start:server" "npm run start:patient" "npm run start:provider"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:patient && npm run build:provider
scripts.lint:all: npx eslint --prefix medical_credit_score_system && npx eslint --prefix provider_admin_portal
